caseNameFull: Boesche, Administrator v. Udall, Secretary of the Interior
attorneys: Scott A. Pfohl and A. O. McClintock on the motion.

opinions.text: Certiorari, ante, p. 886, to the United States Court of Appeals for the District of Columbia Circuit. The motion of the Rocky Mountain Oil & Gas Assn, for leave to present oral argument, as amicus curiae, is denied.
